collection.method: Twelve <=2-hour API windows below 1000 results each; four core workflows; all job attempts and pagination; resumable transient-network retries; exact-head PR file classification only when still matching; fork bridge heads left unlinked.

job_metrics.name:
github.event_name == 'pull_request' &&
    github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name != github.repository &&
    'Fork Nix check runs in trusted-fork-pr-ci' ||
    'Build artifacts + imports check'

github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name != github.repository &&
    'Build artifacts + imports check' ||
    'Fork Nix check not applicable'

gate_headroom.clock: Gate offsets are elapsed seconds from each head's labeled workflow-start proxy, as supplied in the reviewed input.
gate_headroom.assumption: Scenarios subtract the stated seconds from observed gate offsets, clipping each at zero, while holding other gate clocks and dependency structure fixed; adjusted completion order may change. This is a conditional upper-bound sensitivity, not a treatment effect or actual auto-merge readiness; do not add worker or CPU times.

clock_limits.start: earliest core workflow creation per exact PR head; not push time
clock_limits.stop: latest observed required-job completion if all three latest attempts succeeded
clock_limits.auto_merge_readiness: not measured: historical conflicts/draft/extra-approval eligibility unavailable
clock_limits.agent_availability: not measured: no API first-availability polling or webhook/inbox/harness trace
clock_limits.forks: 90 direct-event heads use the separate trusted-fork route; jobs timed separately; no exact-head feedback proxy claimed
clock_limits.histories: cached target-history durations used only to locate candidates; cost comes from originating execution metadata; no cached-duration deduplication heuristic

historical_assessment.recommendation: Defer cross-run base-hash caching in this minute-scale pass

historical_assessment.actual_cache_spike: Not performed; no transport or hit-rate claim
historical_assessment.coverage_limit: Root .bazelignore excludes nested modules even with //...; independent of caching

hash_cache_recommendation_correction.finding: Prior deferral was incorrectly revived. Base/candidate query durations and PR/push overhead are not a matched intervention measurement; shared Skyframe warm-up may move to the candidate on a base-cache hit.
hash_cache_recommendation_correction.replacement_recommendation: Defer cross-run caching: measured ideal-hit consumer saving is small; current production/lookup cost and hit frequency remain unmeasured. See complete experiment and revisit conditions.

new_performance_measurements.method: cProfile of complete CI driver; only base checkout/hash replaced by local digest-checked seed. Normal RBE, test/build/lint/probe paths retained; cold means fresh JVM, disk/repositories/RBE caches retained. Producer and network lookup excluded from hit timing.
new_performance_measurements.warmup_confound: cold-1 normal fetched Rust toolchain (19.669s repository event) and test analysis/execution took41.164s versus8.756s on cold-4; do not attribute initial cold1-vs-cold2 gap to cache
new_performance_measurements.conclusion: Defer implementation; a local hit has a small measured saving on this input, but fleet net benefit after production, lookup and miss/hit frequency is unmeasured.
